independentDisposition.reason: The real source render is near-black and the monumental frontage, process detail, roof hierarchy, and warm material groups do not survive unaided inspection.

meshOrientation.finding: The frozen cyclic basis is orientation-preserving. The source box primitives themselves carried inward authored winding; after the coordinate bridge those faces remained inward and suppressed governed lighting response until explicitly reversed.

openClassification.requirement: all authored face normals point upward

lightingReach.finding: The configured area lights were aimed at the governed process-hall target, but their authored values were too weak for their 115-154 world-unit throw at the source-scale scene.

colorManagement.finding: The high-contrast look amplified the already deficient face-normal and light-reach signal; it was not the primary cause. Raw color management remains frozen. The semantic pass is now isolated to Standard/None with pure emission so component IDs remain measurable.

camera.finding: The camera is registration-correct and is not the repair lever. The 514-pixel occupied width already spans about 64.25 literal-192 pixels; zooming or shifting would violate the frozen source registration rather than fix the low visual mass.

deadVisibilityGate.finding: LIGHTING-CONTRACT.json declared median, p95, and portal-frame gates, but the Process-A child never decoded the rendered PNGs or evaluated those fields. It therefore wrote a completion receipt for an image that violated every luma/frontage gate.
deadVisibilityGate.repair: The child now decodes non-interlaced RGBA8 PNG bytes, measures alpha-aware occupancy/luma and semantic frontage cores, and fails before saving the blend or completion evidence.

implemented: reverse source box face winding exactly once after the orientation-preserving bridge
audit every solid mesh as a closed outward shell or explicit open two-sided receiver
apply provenance-bound deterministic source-scale energy gains while preserving authored light inputs and aim
emit non-saturating pure-emission semantic IDs under isolated color management
enforce alpha-aware occupancy, luma, portal-frame, and freight-depth gates against actual rendered bytes

proofLimits.nextAuthority: Independent frontier review must accept this zero-DCC repair before any new Blender process is authorized.
